PARTIES AND BACKGROUND
This Synthetic Company Service Agreement (the “Agreement”) is made between Northstar Digital Solutions
Private Limited, a fictional company incorporated in India with its fictional office at 14 Innovation Park, Bengaluru,
Karnataka 560001 (the “Company”), and BluePeak Analytics Private Limited, a fictional service provider with its
fictional office at 22 Business Avenue, Kochi, Kerala 682030 (the “Service Provider”).

clauses.clause_text:
The parties wish to establish
terms under which the Service Provider will provide software development, data processing, and technical support
services to the Company.

DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATION
“Confidential Information” means non-public business, financial, technical, operational, customer, security,
source-code, product, and commercial information disclosed by or on behalf of a party. “Services” means the
software development, data processing, maintenance, and support services described in an agreed statement of
work.

EFFECTIVE DATE AND TERM
This Agreement becomes effective on 1 October 2026 (the “Effective Date”) and, unless terminated earlier in
accordance with this Agreement, will remain in force until 30 September 2027 (the “Expiration Date”).

SERVICES AND DELIVERABLES
The Service Provider shall design, develop, test, and maintain the software modules listed in each statement of
work.

The Company shall review each deliverable within ten business days and shall provide written

clauses.clause_text:
FEES AND PAYMENT TERMS
The Company shall pay the Service Provider a fixed service fee of INR 4,50,000 per project milestone, subject to
acceptance of the applicable deliverable.

be notified in writing with reasonable details, and the parties shall work in good faith to resolve the dispute.

clauses.clause_text:
CONFIDENTIALITY
Each receiving party shall protect the other party's Confidential Information using at least the same degree of care
it uses to protect its own similar information, and in no event less than reasonable care.

The receiving party shall
use Confidential Information only to perform or receive the Services and shall not disclose it to any third party
except to employees and professional advisers who need to know the information and are bound by confidentiality
obligations.

The Service Provider shall implement reasonable administrative, technical, and organisational safeguards to
protect personal data processed for the Company.

security incident affecting Company data.

libraries, templates, and general know-how.

Each party represents that it has the authority to enter into this Agreement.

clauses.clause_text:
INDEMNIFICATION
The Service Provider shall defend and indemnify the Company against third-party claims alleging that the
deliverables, as supplied by the Service Provider and used in accordance with this Agreement, infringe a third
party's intellectual property rights.

clauses.clause_text:
The Company shall promptly notify the Service Provider of the claim and
provide reasonable cooperation.

clauses.clause_text:
The indemnifying party shall not settle a claim in a manner that admits liability on
behalf of the other party or imposes non-monetary obligations without the other party's prior written consent.

clauses.clause_text:
LIMITATION OF LIABILITY
Except for liability arising from fraud, wilful misconduct, breach of confidentiality, infringement of intellectual
property rights, or payment obligations, neither party shall be liable for indirect, incidental, special, punitive, or
consequential loss, including loss of profits or anticipated savings.

Subject to those exclusions, each party's
aggregate liability under this Agreement shall not exceed the total fees paid or payable under the relevant
statement of work during the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim.

clauses.clause_text:
ASSIGNMENT
Neither party may assign or transfer this Agreement, in whole or in part, without the prior written consent of the
other party, except that either party may assign this Agreement to an affiliate or to a successor in connection with a
merger, corporate reorganisation, or sale of substantially all of its relevant business, provided that the successor
agrees in writing to be bound by this Agreement.

Either party may terminate this Agreement for convenience by giving the other party sixty days' prior written notice.

clauses.clause_text:
Either party may terminate immediately by written notice if the other party commits a material breach and fails to
remedy that breach within thirty days after receiving written notice describing the breach.

clauses.clause_text:
Provisions
which by their nature should survive termination shall continue to apply.

Neither party shall be responsible for delay or failure to perform caused by events beyond its reasonable control,
including natural disasters, acts of government, widespread telecommunications failure, or civil disturbance,
